answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Proof of unique Bluetooth MAC rotation pattern stops them at the door: a device whose address rotated on a human schedule, not a farm schedule, which means the ledge of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the ridge is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the prism for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
